_comment: Custom Vanilla Minecraft egg. Import this via Panel > Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Minecraft: Vanilla (Custom)
author: you@example.com
description: Vanilla Minecraft server running on a self-built Docker image.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Pterodactyl Vanilla Minecraft installation script
#
# This runs inside a throwaway container built FROM the same base image,
# with /mnt/server mounted to what becomes /home/container at runtime.
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl jq

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -sSL https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json | jq -r '.latest.release')
fi

echo "Installing Minecraft version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"

MANIFEST_URL=$(curl -sSL https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json | jq -r --arg VERSION "$MINECRAFT_VERSION" '.versions[] | select(.id == $VERSION) | .url')

if [ -z "$MANIFEST_URL" ]; then
    echo "Could not find that Minecraft version in Mojang's manifest."
    exit 1
fi

DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sSL "$MANIFEST_URL" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url')
curl -o "${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"

echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Install complete."

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run the server with.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The version of Minecraft to download and install. Use 'latest' for the newest release.
